task.title: Add a New Phone to Duo
task.shortdesc: Reconnecting or transferring Duo authentication when replacing, losing, or upgrading your phone.

prereq.p: Before starting, check which scenario applies to your new phone:

ul.li: You had the Duo Mobile app on your old phone and kept the same phone number: Follow the steps below to reactivate the Duo Mobile app on your new phone.

You did not have the Duo Mobile app on your old phone (text message codes only) and kept the same phone number: You do not need to follow these instructions; you will continue receiving two-factor verification codes by text automatically without taking any action.
Your phone number changed with your new phone: Contact the NC State Help Desk at 919-515-4357 (HELP) for further instructions on setting up your new phone number for two-factor authentication.

context.p: Reconnecting Duo Mobile on a replacement phone with the same phone number follows the same process for all NC State students, faculty, and staff. Complete the browser steps on a computer so you can scan the activation QR code with your new phone.

step.cmd: On your computer, open a web browser and go to https://docs.shib.ncsu.edu/duoenroll/.
Sign in with your NC State Unity ID and password.
Leave the Passcode field empty, select Enter a Passcode, and select Text me new codes in the blue box at the bottom of the page.
Enter the verification code texted to your phone into the Login field and select Log in to open the My Settings and Device page.
Select Device Options next to your old phone entry and select Reactivate DUO Mobile to display a QR code.
Open the Duo Mobile app on your new phone, follow the prompts to add a new account, and scan the QR code displayed on your computer screen.

postreq.p: After completing these steps, your new phone will be active for Duo authentication. You can now use the Duo Mobile app to receive verification codes.
